Name: Hold To Break Geodes
Author: CatCattyCat
Description:
[size=6]Hold to Break Geodes
[/size]
[size=3]This mod lets you hold your mouse/controller down to continuously break open geodes - you don't have to click every time! It is compatible with (and especially useful with) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1089/?]Fast Animations[/url]!

Simply hold your mouse/controller when you go to break open a geode and Clint will keep breaking geodes open as long as you have geodes of the same type to break.[/size]

[size=3]This mod requires [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]SMAPI[/url] by Pathoschild. To install, place the HoldToBreakGeodes folder in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/size]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/44734342?tab=user+files][size=5]Check out my other mods by clicking here![/size][/url]

Downloads.Description: Place in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder to install. Requires SMAPI v2.9+
